1.

The petitioner has prayed for a direction to the respondents to to pay compensation/solatium to him for having taken over his land bearing Arazi No. 14, area 0.091 hectare, at prevailing circle rate,
as per provisions of Section 26(1)(ka) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and for a further direction to the respondents to decide various representations made by him from time to time.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. In pursuance of our previous order, learned Standing Counsel is in receipt of written instructions from Executive Engineer, Construction Division-II, PWD, Gorakhpur, according to which, no part of the land of the petitioner has been utilized for construction of dam and road, as is being alleged by the petitioner.

It is also stated that the road is in existence since the year 1981 - 1982 over part of Ram Prakash Chaudhary vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71446466/

3. It appears from the rival contentions that there is dispute of identity of the land of the petitioner.
We leave it open to the petitioner to get his holding demarcated in appropriate proceedings.
4. The petition stands disposed of with the aforesaid liberty to the petitioner.
